caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular piece of textile or needlework with a predominantly deep red background. The central and upper left portions are covered by a dense arrangement of flowers and leaves rendered in multiple colors, including shades of white, pink, red, orange, yellow, green, and touches of black and gray. The flowers are depicted in various sizes and appear to overlap each other, with green leaves interspersed among them. The lower and right edges are bordered by a wide band of solid red, textured to resemble a fabric fringe or heavy woven material. The floral arrangement appears asymmetrical, concentrating heavily toward the upper left and center, while the rest of the piece is primarily red with the textured border. The entire composition sits on a neutral, light-colored background.
title: Table Cover (Chenille)
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
